name: set_call_intent
description: Call this as soon as you understand the reason for this call. Do NOT wait — identify the intent and call this immediately, then continue helping in the same response.

name: end_call
description: Signal that the conversation is naturally complete and it is time to end the call. You MUST write your warm sign-off in the SAME response as this call — thank them for their time and wish them well. Nothing you say after this is heard.

reason.description: Brief reason the call is ending

name: confirm_identity
description: Call this once you have established who you are speaking to, before sharing any details of the enquiry or looking anything up for them. Pass name_confirmed: true only once the person THEMSELVES confirms they are Priya -- never on a gatekeeper's, receptionist's or relative's word. Pass name_confirmed: false if this is the wrong person, a gatekeeper, a child, or you could not confirm who you are speaking to -- share nothing further in that case: ask them to put you through, or offer a callback instead.

name_confirmed.description: True once the person's identity is confirmed, false otherwise
